Quirks preserved: same-unit copies keep invalid sequences verbatim, converted copies drop illegal symbols but still count them in Length(). Compared bit-for-bit with OCCT by the ncoll_utilities_utf probe.

Creates an unlocked recursive mutex. Loading native C++ libraries has no meaning for the port: PluginLoader takes the resource io/environment, a PluginLibraries seam (StaticPluginLibraries registers PLUGINFACTORY factories by library file name) and a console writer. It reads <GUID>.Location from a fresh "Plugin" ResourceCatalog, builds lib<name>.so / lib<name>.dylib / <name>.dll, and raises Plugin_Failure with the native messages ("could not find the resource:...\n", "could not open:<name>; reason:<dlerror>", "could not find the factory in:<name><dlerror>"), printing the first two to the console when verbose with the native spacing. Refusals use glibc's dlerror wording. The native cache is process-wide; here it belongs to the loader, and only successes are cached as natively. The theVerbose default (true) is passed explicitly. The product type is the factory's return type (native: handle<Standard_Transient>). The differential probe (services_ operations) compares it with the native kernel.

Linux/macOS order kept (SetFloatingSignal, record the mode, then handlers unless AsIs). Ported: the mode record, the floating-point traps, the SIGINT handler that arms ControlBreak (SetUnhandled restores a previous non-default SIGINT handler), and Unset restoring SIG_DFL on all eight managed signals. Rust cannot unwind or long-jump out of a signal handler (or translate Windows structured exceptions into panics), so the handlers that turn SIGSEGV, SIGFPE, SIGILL, SIGBUS, SIGHUP, SIGQUIT, SIGSYS (and SEH) into OSD_SIG*/OSD_Exception_* C++ exceptions are not installed. Windows: records the mode, honours CSF_DEBUG_MODE (message, stack trace length 10 when 0), installs/removes the console Ctrl-C/Ctrl-Break handler (MessageBeep not ported; other console events exit(254)), clears the break flag, then SetThreadLocalSignal; the unhandled-exception filter and signal() translators are not installed. SignalState::set_signal with an injected SignalHost is the testable form. Probes osd_signal/osd_ctrl_break.

Forwards to SetSignal(OSD_SignalMode_Set, floating), with the same partial port. Rust cannot unwind or long-jump out of a signal handler (or translate Windows structured exceptions into panics), so the handlers that turn SIGSEGV, SIGFPE, SIGILL, SIGBUS, SIGHUP, SIGQUIT, SIGSYS (and SEH) into OSD_SIG*/OSD_Exception_* C++ exceptions are not installed.

Unix/macOS: exactly SetFloatingSignal(floating), as natively (mode ignored). Windows: the _set_se_translator part is not ported (SE translation raises C++ exceptions); the floating-point part is. Probe osd_thread_signal.

Linux/glibc (x86, x86-64, AArch64): feclearexcept(FE_ALL_EXCEPT) then feenable/fedisableexcept(FE_INVALID|FE_DIVBYZERO|FE_OVERFLOW) for the calling thread, as natively; other Unix targets (macOS, musl) do nothing, as the native #else branch. The abstract base maps to the FileSystem trait; implementing it is the Rust constructor. std::istream/std::ostream/std::streambuf shared pointers become the project-owned SharedIStream/SharedOStream/SharedStreamBuf (Arc<Mutex<dyn IStream/OStream/StreamBuf>>) with the libstdc++ sentry and state rules; the handle is FileSystemHandle (Arc<dyn FileSystem>) because the crate Handle<T> projects to one concrete type while file systems are an open interface. Mutating virtuals take &self and lock internally (the default file system is shared process-wide). Exceptions (Standard_ASSERT_RAISE) become Err(Standard_ProgramError) with the native message; the assert names the source basename where the native text carries the absolute build path. Host independent: std::fs gives the same behavior on Linux, Windows and macOS (Unicode paths reach the native wide-character APIs on Windows).

FILE* becomes Option<std::fs::File> (None for NULL). Linux converts the name to UTF-8 and parses the mode as glibc fopen does ('r'/'w'/'a' then up to six modifiers: '+' update, 'x' exclusive, others ignored; a write-only append stream starts at the end). The extern "C" OSD_OpenFile(const char*, const char*) is open_file_utf8. Windows: _wfopen accepts the MSVC mode letters (e.g. 't', 'ccs='); the Rust parser keeps the glibc rules on every host. Probe osd_fs_fopen (22 modes).
stat().st_ctime in seconds, 0 when stat fails. Linux/macOS: status-change time (MetadataExt::ctime); Windows: _wstat64 st_ctime is the creation time, read from Metadata::created. Probe osd_fs_ctime.

The descriptor becomes Option<std::fs::File> (None for -1). Native quirk kept: any mode with out is O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_TRUNC (+O_APPEND with app) even with in or without trunc, since O_RDONLY is 0; no out opens read-only; created files get 0600. Windows: _wsopen_s with the same flags; its text-mode translation (no binary) is not reproduced. Probe osd_fs_fd covers all 64 modes.

std::filebuf is FileBuffer: the libstdc++ openmode table (binary ignored, invalid combinations refused, ate seeks to the end), glibc's end start for write-only append, unbuffered reads and the libstdc++ put area (pending small writes; pubseekoff(0, cur) adds them to the file offset). Windows/MinGW open the same modes through std. Probe osd_fs_filebuf covers all 64 modes.

The template over std::ifstream/ofstream/fstream becomes FileStream (input/output/input_output adds in/out/nothing); open failure sets failbit, success clears the state. Probe osd_fs_fstream. Host independent: std::fs gives the same behavior on Linux, Windows and macOS (Unicode paths reach the native wide-character APIs on Windows).

Enumeration with native declaration order as i32 discriminants; `ALL` lists the values and `from_raw` inverts `as i32`. Host independent.

The extern "C" overload: fopen of a UTF-8 name; FILE* becomes Option<std::fs::File> (None for NULL), with the glibc mode parsing of open_file. The implicit conversion to the stored linear RGB triple is the explicit rgb_vec3 accessor; Rust has no implicit conversion operators.
The reinterpret_cast view of RGB plus alpha as one Vec4 is the explicit to_vec4 copy; Rust has no implicit conversion operators.
The upcast to a const reference of a base handle, without a count change, is Handle::view::<Base>(); both preprocessor branches (SFINAE and legacy) declare it.

Deprecated upcast to a non-const reference of a base handle (#26377): assigning through it would store a base-typed object in a derived handle. Safe Rust cannot alias one handle as another handle type mutably; callers assign Handle::cast or Handle::into_cast results instead.

tests.native_expected_failure: Fails in native OCCT itself on the pinned profile (GCC, glibc): the test inlines ElCLib::Value(-0.7, hyperbola), and GCC folds sinh(-0.7) at compile time to a value one ulp from the glibc run-time sinh that ExtremaPC2d_Hyperbola::Value calls, so the EXPECT_EQ(..., 0.0) distance is 1 ulp natively. The Rust port calls the run-time sinh on both sides, as the native library does, and passes. Approved by the maintainer on 2026-09-29.
